name: Security Check on API Files
description: When API route files are created, remind the agent to verify security best practices

then.prompt: A new API/route/middleware file was created. Verify it includes: 1) Input validation (preferably with Zod), 2) Proper authentication/authorization checks, 3) Rate limiting consideration, 4) No sensitive data in error responses, 5) Parameterized queries if database access is involved.
